description: CommandMate #3003, the negative half: the same names written OUTSIDE the deliverable heading do not reach the scope. The declared-only source is read under the heading and nowhere else, so `Makefile` in prose extracts nothing at all, and the backtick `.ebnf` path in prose is reported with the rest of the prose (`prose_path_ignored`, notice) and sent to `reference_files` — NOT as `unrecognized_file_extension`, because in an issue that has a deliverable heading the extension is not why a prose path is out of scope, and telling the author to change it would be a misdiagnosis. A body with no deliverable heading keeps the old warning (16-unrecognized-extension).
